quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah forgiveth not that a partner should be ascribed unto Him. He forgiveth (all) save that to whom He will. Whoso ascribeth partners to Allah, he hath indeed invented a tremendous sin.

explanation.bs: Allah neće oprostiti da Mu se pridružuju druga božanstva (širk), a manje od toga oprostit će kome hoće.
explanation.en: Allah does not forgive association with Him, but forgives what is less than that for whom He wills.

quranTranslation.text: Tell those who believe to forgive those who hope not for the days of Allah; in order that He may requite folk what they used to earn.

explanation.bs: „Reci onima koji vjeruju neka oproste“ – غَفَرَ među ljudima.
explanation.en: “Tell those who believe to forgive” — غَفَرَ between people.

quranTranslation.text: Allah tasketh not a soul beyond its scope. For it (is only) that which it hath earned, and against it (only) that which it hath deserved. Our Lord! Condemn us not if we forget, or miss the mark! Our Lord! Lay not on us such a burden as thou didst lay on those before us! Our Lord! Impose not on us that which we have not the strength to bear! Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us, Thou, our Protector, and give us victory over the disbelieving folk.

explanation.bs: „Pređi preko nas, oprosti nam i smiluj nam se“ – عَفَا i غَفَرَ jedno uz drugo.
explanation.en: “Pardon us, absolve us and have mercy on us” — عَفَا and غَفَرَ side by side.

quranTranslation.text: And let not those who possess dignity and ease among you swear not to give to the near of kin and to the needy, and to fugitives for the cause of Allah. Let them forgive and show indulgence. Yearn ye not that Allah may forgive you? Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.

explanation.bs: „I neka pređu preko toga i neka ne zamjeraju“ – oprost među ljudima.
explanation.en: “Let them forgive and show indulgence” — pardon between people.

quranTranslation.text: Whatever of misfortune striketh you, it is what your right hands have earned. And He forgiveth much.

explanation.bs: Nesreće vas pogađaju zbog onoga što činite, a On mnogo prašta (يَعْفُو).
explanation.en: Disaster strikes you for what your hands have earned, but He pardons much (يَعْفُو).

quranTranslation.text: If ye avoid the great (things) which ye are forbidden, We will remit from you your evil deeds and make you enter at a noble gate.

explanation.bs: Ako se klonite velikih grijeha, izbrisat ćemo vam loša djela (prema većini mufessira: manje grijehe) – كَفَّرَ za loša djela.
explanation.en: If you avoid the major sins, We will remove from you your misdeeds (most mufassirun: the lesser sins) — كَفَّرَ for bad deeds.

quranTranslation.text: And their Lord hath heard them (and He saith): Lo! I suffer not the work of any worker, male or female, to be lost. Ye proceed one from another. So those who fled and were driven forth from their homes and suffered damage for My cause, and fought and were slain, verily I shall remit their evil deeds from them and verily I shall bring them into Gardens underneath which rivers flow - A reward from Allah. And with Allah is the fairest of rewards.

explanation.bs: „Sigurno ću im izbrisati njihova loša djela i sigurno ću ih uvesti u bašče.“
explanation.en: “Verily I shall remit their evil deeds from them and verily I shall bring them into Gardens.”

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Turn unto Allah in sincere repentance! It may be that your Lord will remit from you your evil deeds and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, on the day when Allah will not abase the Prophet and those who believe with him. Their light will run before them and on their right hands; they will say: Our Lord! Perfect our light for us, and forgive us! Lo! Thou art Able to do all things.

explanation.bs: Iskreno pokajanje – nada da će Gospodar izbrisati loša djela.
explanation.en: Sincere repentance — the hope that your Lord will remove your misdeeds.

quranTranslation.text: Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).

explanation.bs: „Idi faraonu, on je zaista prešao granicu.“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “Go thou unto Pharaoh! Lo! he hath transgressed (the bounds).” — ar-Rāġib cites these words.

gloss.en: to transgress, to exceed the bounds

quranTranslation.text: Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship

explanation.bs: „Kad je voda prešla granicu, Mi smo vas ponijeli u lađi koja plovi“ – voda koja pređe svoju mjeru; ar-Rāġib kaže da je riječ ovdje prenesena.
explanation.en: “Lo! when the waters rose, We carried you upon the ship” — water passing its measure; ar-Rāġib says the word is borrowed here.

gloss.en: to transgress, to exceed the bounds

quranTranslation.text: Nay, but verily man is rebellious

explanation.bs: „Nikako! Čovjek zaista prelazi granicu“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Nay, but verily man is rebellious” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to transgress, to exceed the bounds

quranTranslation.text: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;

explanation.bs: „Pa su se oglušili o naredbu svoga Gospodara, i zahvatio ih je grom dok su gledali.“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to defy, to turn away from obedience

quranTranslation.text: And how many a community revolted against the ordinance of its Lord and His messengers, and We called it to a stern account and punished it with dire punishment,

explanation.bs: „Koliko je naselja koja su se oglušila o naredbu svoga Gospodara i Njegovih poslanika …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And how many a community revolted against the ordinance of its Lord and His messengers” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

gloss.en: to defy, to turn away from obedience

quranTranslation.text: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.

explanation.bs: „A Allah povećava uputu onima koji su na Pravom putu“ – kako Njemu priliči; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright” — as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Their Prophet said unto them: Lo! Allah hath raised up Saul to be a king for you. They said: How can he have kingdom over us when we are more deserving of the kingdom than he is, since he hath not been given wealth enough? He said: Lo! Allah hath chosen him above you, and hath increased him abundantly in wisdom and stature. Allah bestoweth His Sovereignty on whom He will. Allah is All-Embracing, All-Knowing.

explanation.bs: „… i dao mu je više znanja i tijela“ – ar-Rāġib, koji navodi ovaj ajet, kaže: više nego ljudima njegova vremena.
explanation.en: “And hath increased him abundantly in wisdom and stature” — ar-Rāġib, who cites this ayah, says: more than the people of his time.

quranTranslation.text: And they swore by Allah, their most binding oath, that if a warner came unto them they would be more tractable than any of the nations; yet, when a warner came unto them it aroused in them naught save repugnance,

explanation.bs: „… a kad im je došao opominjač, to im je povećalo samo odbojnost“ – pokuđeno povećanje; ar-Rāġib navodi ove riječi.
explanation.en: “When a warner came unto them it aroused in them naught save repugnance” — the warner's coming only increased their aversion, a blameworthy increase; ar-Rāġib cites these words.

quranTranslation.text: Lo! Allah wrongeth not even of the weight of an ant; and if there is a good deed, He will double it and will give (the doer) from His presence an immense reward.

explanation.bs: „Allah, zaista, ni koliko trun ne čini nepravdu; a ako je dobro djelo, On ga umnoži“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And if there is a good deed, He will double it” — as befits Him; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him and his may be a rich reward?

explanation.bs: „Ko je taj koji će Allahu dati lijep zajam, pa da mu ga On umnoži …“ – trošenje na Allahovu putu, koje On, Kojem ništa ne treba, naziva zajmom; vraća se umnoženo.
explanation.en: “Who is he that will lend unto Allah a goodly loan, that He may double it for him” — spending in Allah's way, which He, free of need, calls a loan; it is returned multiplied.

quranTranslation.text: The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein disdained for ever;

explanation.bs: „… udvostručit će mu se kazna na Sudnjem danu“ – udvostručenje i u kazni.
explanation.en: “The doom will be doubled for him on the Day of Resurrection” — doubling in punishment too.

quranTranslation.text: The Creator of the heavens and the earth. He hath made for you pairs of yourselves, and of the cattle also pairs, whereby He multiplieth you. Naught is as His likeness; and He is the Hearer, the Seer.

explanation.bs: „… Ništa nije poput Njega; On je Onaj Koji čuje i vidi“ – ar-Rāġib: zanijekana je sličnost u svakom pogledu.
explanation.en: “Naught is as His likeness; and He is the Hearer, the Seer” — ar-Rāġib: likeness in every respect is denied.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Verily, though mankind and the jinn should assemble to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like thereof though they were helpers one of another.

explanation.bs: „… kad bi se ljudi i džini okupili da donesu nešto poput ovog Kur'ana, ne bi donijeli nešto poput njega …“
explanation.en: “Though mankind and the jinn should assemble to produce the like of this Qur'an, they could not produce the like thereof”

quranTranslation.text: Who hath appointed the earth a resting-place for you, and the sky a canopy; and causeth water to pour down from the sky, thereby producing fruits as food for you. And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better).

explanation.bs: „… zato ne činite Allahu takmace, a vi znate“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And do not set up rivals to Allah when ye know (better)” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: Yet of mankind are some who take unto themselves (objects of worship which they set as) rivals to Allah, loving them with a love like (that which is the due) of Allah (only) - those who believe are stauncher in their love for Allah - Oh, that those who do evil had but known, (on the day) when they behold the doom, that power belongeth wholly to Allah, and that Allah is severe in punishment!

explanation.bs: „Ima ljudi koji pored Allaha uzimaju sebi takmace i ljube ih ljubavlju kakvom se ljubi Allah …“ – takmac kome se daje ljubav koja pripada samo Allahu.
explanation.en: “Yet of mankind are some who take unto themselves (objects of worship which they set as) rivals to Allah, loving them with a love like (that which is the due) of Allah (only)” — a rival given the love that is due to Allah alone.

quranTranslation.text: And there is none comparable unto Him.

explanation.bs: „I nema nikoga ko bi Mu bio ravan“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And there is none comparable unto Him” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.
